output.reason: The release note [ev-78de9d381925] only says "add name and labels in cluster metrics". Linked issue [ev-68d02bc75fe0] covers part of it: it asks for a "name" label on argocd_cluster_connection_status, alongside "server". The PR description [ev-7c0b64694e6f][ev-30512fc0f8e3] is just a checklist, so the evidence never says which cluster metrics got the label or what the "labels" part is. The changed-files list [ev-41e40f932439] touches the application-controller command and its server-commands doc, which hints at a new controller option, but its name, default and whether you must turn it on are not shown. That leaves the subject, who is affected and the consequence for the "labels" half open; the metrics.md and controller-flag doc diffs are needed.
